description.value: Jade City is a world-renowned stop on the Cassiar-Stewart Highway (Hwy-37) in Northern BC, offering seven accommodation units — cabins, a bungalow, and a four-room motel — set among jade boulders and mining equipment on a working jade mining property founded in 1985. During the summer season, guests can watch live jade cutting and polishing demonstrations steps from their door, and the on-site jade store is less than 100 feet from any room. The property gained international recognition as the setting for the Discovery Channel series Jade Fever.
